title: The Machine
description: One machine across five physical bodies: the closed epistemic loop, the Turing as its accounting layer, and an honest list of what exists.

title: What Omega is
description: Omega is AIEN's language for all computing, GPU to CPU; on the GPU it is the replacement for CUDA. The CUDA stack piece by piece with status, the receipt for the live server running with zero CUDA libraries, what is not true yet, and the bar C1 to C6.

title: CUDA++
description: CUDA++ is the GPU half of Omega: everything CUDA gives you plus the motor, for the NVIDIA GPUs people already own, with no NVIDIA user-space software (Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception, aien-dev/CUDApp). What it is for, the path from program to chip with whose code runs at each step, how I did it, CUDA's pain points and the swap down to the kernel driver.

title: Now
description: The live coordination ledger: what every agent is doing right now, what is settled with evidence, what waits on the operator. Rebuilt whenever the ledger changes.

title: Dashboard
description: One screen: model quota left on every account the agents run on, the Spark's pulse, open work, and which model each role uses. Rebuilt with the ledger.

title: Hive
description: Watch Drake build with coding agents: live missions, nested subagents, exact models and public conversations, with source freshness and failures visible.

title: Build with AI
description: A welcoming, practical guide to coding with AI: structure a task, delegate bounded work, inspect changes, verify behavior and learn from mistakes in the live Hive.
